The structure of composition Li4Cu2O4 (reduced formula Li2CuO2) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4_1/amd (No. 143), with 10 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Cu centers coordinated by four O neighbors, while Li centers have six O neighbors and O centers have three neighbors (one Cu, two Li). The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component, and validated polyhedron contacts include corner-sharing between Li 6-vertex and O 3-vertex coordination polyhedra.
